resources.string: Drives the login and screens of the allowlisted test applications

Internal test driver. While a test run is active this service reads the screen of the allowlisted test application in order to find fields and buttons, type the credentials you entered in the tool, and tap through the app. It is limited to those applications plus the Android screens a run needs (Settings, the permission prompts and the screen-recording prompt), and cannot see any other app on this device. It does not read notifications, SMS or the keyboard, and it never records the credential values.
